title: 加州地下水補注系統 GWRS~Orange County Groundwater Replenishment System
focus: 高級處理與地下水補注的連續證據~Evidence across advanced treatment and aquifer recharge
summary: GWRS將膜處理與UV/H₂O₂後的水送至補注系統。本課追蹤水質障壁、補注能力與地下水傳輸，避免把地下水視為無限儲槽。~GWRS sends membrane- and UV/H₂O₂-treated water to recharge systems. This lesson follows barriers, recharge capacity and aquifer transport without assuming unlimited groundwater storage.

units.title: 微濾前處理：膜通量與有效膜面積~Microfiltration pretreatment: Membrane flux and effective area
units.mechanism: 膜通量是單位膜面積的產水速率；產水流量固定時，增加可用膜面積可降低通量負擔。本單元在「微濾前處理」觀察此因果關係。~Membrane flux is permeate flow per area; additional available membrane area reduces flux loading at fixed production. Examine this relationship at microfiltration pretreatment.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：產水 Qp=96 m³/h、膜面積 A=2400 m²。公式 J=1000Qp/A；代入 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：淨產水通量；應另扣反洗停機，非任何膜產品允許值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: permeate Qp=96 m³/h and membrane area A=2400 m². Formula J=1000Qp/A; substitution 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h). Boundary: Net production flux; backwash downtime is separate and this is not a membrane product limit.
units.verify: 以產水總表與各膜列面積核對，另記反洗時間。在離線場景為「微濾前處理」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Reconcile total permeate with each train area and separately log backwash time. Build an offline evidence table for microfiltration pretreatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 未扣停用膜列會低估剩餘膜列的真實通量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting offline trains understates flux on the remaining membranes. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 膜面積減半但產水不變時通量不變。~Flux stays unchanged when membrane area halves at constant production.
units.practice: 先點選「微濾前處理」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用膜面積降成1920 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 50 L/(m²·h)。與基準 40 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the microfiltration pretreatment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active membrane area to1920 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 50 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 40 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 逆滲透水量分流：逆滲透水回收率~RO water split: Reverse-osmosis water recovery
units.mechanism: 回收率把進水分為產水與濃水；提高回收通常也提高濃水鹽度與結垢風險，不能只追求產水百分比。本單元在「逆滲透水量分流」觀察此因果關係。~Recovery divides feed into permeate and concentrate; higher recovery usually raises concentrate salinity and scaling risk, so production percentage alone is insufficient. Examine this relationship at RO water split.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水 Qf=100 m³/h、產水 Qp=75 m³/h。公式 Y=100Qp/Qf；代入 100*75/100 = 75 %。適用邊界：穩態體積流量且忽略微小密度差；未預測結垢。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: feed Qf=100 m³/h and permeate Qp=75 m³/h. Formula Y=100Qp/Qf; substitution 100*75/100 = 75 %. Boundary: Steady volumetric flow with small density differences neglected; scaling is not predicted.
units.verify: 校核Qf=Qp+Qc，檢查三支流量表的時間同步。在離線場景為「逆滲透水量分流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check Qf=Qp+Qc and synchronize the three flow meters. Build an offline evidence table for RO water split; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 濃水表偏低會製造虛假的高回收，須做總水量平衡。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~An under-reading concentrate meter creates false high recovery; close the water balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 回收率越接近百分之百就一定越好。~Recovery closer to one hundred percent is always preferable.
units.practice: 先點選「逆滲透水量分流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把產水量改成80 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 80 %。與基準 75 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the RO water split measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only permeate to80 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 80 %. Compare with baseline 75 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 產水溶質驗證：鹽分截留與導電度指標~Permeate-solute verification: Salt rejection and conductivity indicators
units.mechanism: 截留率比較進水與產水的同一溶質；導電度是混合離子指標，不能證明所有微量有機物均被截留。本單元在「產水溶質驗證」觀察此因果關係。~Rejection compares the same solute in feed and permeate; conductivity reflects mixed ions and does not prove retention of every trace organic. Examine this relationship at permeate-solute verification.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一溶質Cf=500 mg/L、Cp=5 mg/L。公式 R=100(1-Cp/Cf)；代入 100*(1-5/500) = 99 %。適用邊界：示範單一溶質與配對採樣；離子組成改變需校正導電度解釋。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: same solute Cf=500 mg/L and Cp=5 mg/L. Formula R=100(1-Cp/Cf); substitution 100*(1-5/500) = 99 %. Boundary: One solute and paired sampling; changed ionic composition requires reinterpretation of conductivity.
units.verify: 以標準液校正導電度，並用實驗室分析驗證目標溶質。在離線場景為「產水溶質驗證」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Calibrate conductivity with standards and verify the target solute with laboratory analysis. Build an offline evidence table for permeate-solute verification; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 膜破損、密封旁通與探頭漂移都可能使產水讀值上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Membrane damage, seal bypass and sensor drift can all raise the permeate reading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 高鹽截留率等同所有污染物百分之百去除。~High salt rejection means complete removal of every pollutant.
units.practice: 先點選「產水溶質驗證」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Cp改成10 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 98 %。與基準 99 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the permeate-solute verification measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Cp to10 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 98 %. Compare with baseline 99 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 濃水獨立處置帳：濃水鹽分收支~Separate concentrate ledger: Concentrate salt balance
units.mechanism: 被截留的鹽須從濃水排出；水量與鹽量兩條守恆式共同決定濃水濃度。本單元在「濃水獨立處置帳」觀察此因果關係。~Rejected salt exits in concentrate; conservation of both water and salt determines concentrate concentration. Examine this relationship at separate concentrate ledger.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Qf=100、Qp=75 m³/h；Cf=500、Cp=5 mg/L。公式 Cc=(QfCf-QpCp)/(Qf-Qp)；代入 (100*500-75*5)/(100-75) = 1985 mg/L。適用邊界：穩態無沉澱及吸附；若鹽析出，此式不能描述固相。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Qf=100 and Qp=75 m³/h; Cf=500 and Cp=5 mg/L. Formula Cc=(QfCf-QpCp)/(Qf-Qp); substitution (100*500-75*5)/(100-75) = 1985 mg/L. Boundary: Steady flow without precipitation or adsorption; precipitated solids require another balance.
units.verify: 以進水、產水與濃水三點配對樣核對鹽負荷。在離線場景為「濃水獨立處置帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use paired samples of feed, permeate and concentrate to check salt loads. Build an offline evidence table for separate concentrate ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只計產水品質而不計濃水，會把污染轉移誤認成消失。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Checking only permeate quality mistakes transferred pollution for disappearance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 膜截留的鹽會在系統內自動消失。~Salt rejected by the membrane disappears automatically.
units.practice: 先點選「濃水獨立處置帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qp改成80 m³/h，Cp固定，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2480 mg/L。與基準 1985 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the separate concentrate ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qp to80 m³/h while holding Cp fixed with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2480 mg/L. Compare with baseline 1985 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: UV/AOP光量子模型：紫外線光量概念~UV/AOP fluence submodel: Ultraviolet fluence concept
units.mechanism: 均勻光場下光量為強度乘照射時間；真實反應器須考慮水質透光率、遮蔽與停留分布。本單元在「UV/AOP光量子模型」觀察此因果關係。~In a uniform field, fluence equals intensity times exposure time; real reactors require transmittance, shadowing and residence distributions. Examine this relationship at UV/AOP fluence submodel.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想均勻強度I=2 mW/cm²、照射t=15 s。公式 H=It；代入 2*15 = 30 mJ/cm²。適用邊界：僅單位換算練習，不是病原體認證劑量或飲用水安全判準。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical uniform intensity I=2 mW/cm² and exposuret=15 s. Formula H=It; substitution 2*15 = 30 mJ/cm². Boundary: Unit-conversion exercise only; not a validated pathogen dose or drinking-water safety criterion.
units.verify: 比較燈強度、透光率與流量，指出單一探頭代表不了所有流線。在離線場景為「UV/AOP光量子模型」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare lamp intensity, transmittance and flow, explaining why one sensor does not represent all streamlines. Build an offline evidence table for UV/AOP fluence submodel; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 套管結垢與水中懸浮物可同時降低有效光量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sleeve fouling and suspended particles can both reduce effective fluence. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 燈亮著就表示所有水都接受相同且足夠的光量。~An illuminated lamp means every parcel receives the same sufficient fluence.
units.practice: 先點選「UV/AOP光量子模型」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把假想強度降成1.5 mW/cm²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 22.5 mJ/cm²。與基準 30 mJ/cm²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the UV/AOP fluence submodel measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only hypothetical intensity to1.5 mW/cm² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 22.5 mJ/cm². Compare with baseline 30 mJ/cm² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 多重障壁證據：多重障壁與對數去除~Multiple-barrier evidence: Multiple barriers and log reduction
units.mechanism: 對數去除以濃度比表示，不同障壁只有在適用同一目標且經驗證時才可合併計分。本單元在「多重障壁證據」觀察此因果關係。~Log reduction expresses a concentration ratio; barrier credits combine only for the same target under validated conditions. Examine this relationship at multiple-barrier evidence.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想指標Nin=100000、Nout=100 每單位體積。公式 LRV=log10(Nin/Nout)；代入 log10(100000/100) = 3 log10。適用邊界：純數學示範，檢出限及實際核准信用未包含。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical indicator Nin=100000 and Nout=100 per unit volume. Formula LRV=log10(Nin/Nout); substitution log10(100000/100) = 3 log10. Boundary: Mathematical demonstration only; detection limits and approved treatment credits are excluded.
units.verify: 紀錄檢出限，區分未檢出與零；檢查共同失效是否影響多個障壁。在離線場景為「多重障壁證據」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Record detection limits, distinguish non-detect from zero, and inspect common failures across barriers. Build an offline evidence table for multiple-barrier evidence; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把未檢出當零會算出無限去除，失去可驗證性。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Treating non-detect as zero gives infinite removal and is unverifiable. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 兩個未驗證障壁的標稱數值可以直接當認證效果。~Nominal values for two unvalidated barriers can be treated as certified performance.
units.practice: 先點選「多重障壁證據」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Nout改成1000，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 log10。與基準 3 log10比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the multiple-barrier evidence measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Nout to1000 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 log10. Compare with baseline 3 log10 and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 補注池入滲介面：補注與達西流~Recharge-basin interface: Recharge and Darcy flow
units.mechanism: 飽和多孔介質中的達西通量取決於水力傳導係數與梯度；達西流速不是孔隙內水的速度。本單元在「補注池入滲介面」觀察此因果關係。~Darcy flux in saturated porous media depends on hydraulic conductivity and gradient; it is not the pore-water velocity. Examine this relationship at recharge-basin interface.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：K=5 m/d、梯度i=0.02、截面A=2000 m²。公式 Q=KiA；代入 5*0.02*2000 = 200 m³/d。適用邊界：均質飽和一維近似；不處理裂隙優勢流或非飽和區。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: K=5 m/d, gradienti=0.02 and cross-sectionA=2000 m². Formula Q=KiA; substitution 5*0.02*2000 = 200 m³/d. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated one-dimensional approximation; fractures and the unsaturated zone are excluded.
units.verify: 以觀測井水頭求梯度，分開估計K與有效孔隙率。在離線場景為「補注池入滲介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use observation-well heads to estimate gradient and estimate K separately from effective porosity. Build an offline evidence table for recharge-basin interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 細粒堵塞可降低K，即使水頭相同補注率仍會下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Fine-particle clogging can reduce K and recharge at the same head. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 達西流速與孔隙水流速必定相同。~Darcy flux always equals pore-water velocity.
units.practice: 先點選「補注池入滲介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把K減成3 m/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 120 m³/d。與基準 200 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the recharge-basin interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only K to3 m/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 120 m³/d. Compare with baseline 200 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 觀測井與含水層傳輸：地下水名目傳輸時間~Monitoring wells and aquifer transport: Nominal groundwater travel time
units.mechanism: 孔隙水速度約為Ki/ne；傳輸時間還受彌散、吸附及優勢流影響。本單元在「觀測井與含水層傳輸」觀察此因果關係。~Pore-water velocity is approximately Ki/ne; dispersion, sorption and preferential flow further influence travel. Examine this relationship at monitoring wells and aquifer transport.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：距離L=100 m、有效孔隙率ne=0.25、K=5 m/d、i=0.02。公式 t=Lne/(Ki)；代入 100*0.25/(5*0.02) = 250 d。適用邊界：均質平流示範，不是衛生防護距離或實際最短停留時間。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: distanceL=100 m, effective porosityne=0.25, K=5 m/d andi=0.02. Formula t=Lne/(Ki); substitution 100*0.25/(5*0.02) = 250 d. Boundary: Homogeneous advective example; not a sanitary setback or actual minimum residence time.
units.verify: 用保守示蹤與觀測井分布比較最早突破，不能只看平均。在離線場景為「觀測井與含水層傳輸」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare early breakthrough using a conservative tracer and monitoring wells, not only the mean. Build an offline evidence table for monitoring wells and aquifer transport; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 砂礫透鏡造成的快速通道會使平均模型過於樂觀。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A permeable gravel lens can make the mean model overoptimistic. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 平均傳輸時間保證所有污染物都有同樣衰減。~Mean travel time guarantees identical attenuation for all contaminants.
units.practice: 先點選「觀測井與含水層傳輸」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把梯度改成0.04，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 125 d。與基準 250 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the monitoring wells and aquifer transport measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gradient to0.04 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 125 d. Compare with baseline 250 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 輸送與注入能耗：提升水頭與電力~Conveyance and injection energy: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「輸送與注入能耗」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at conveyance and injection energy.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「輸送與注入能耗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for conveyance and injection energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「輸送與注入能耗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the conveyance and injection energy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 配對井水與儀表樣品：感測器偏移校正~Paired well-water and sensor samples: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「配對井水與儀表樣品」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at paired well-water and sensor samples.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「配對井水與儀表樣品」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for paired well-water and sensor samples; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「配對井水與儀表樣品」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the paired well-water and sensor samples measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: OCWD公開流程列出微濾、逆滲透和紫外線搭配過氧化氫，並以入滲池及注入方式補充地下水。~OCWD documents microfiltration, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet light with hydrogen peroxide, followed by basin and well recharge.
